name: George Krikes
bio: George Krikes is a Los Angeles singer-songwriter and guitarist whose site describes his sound as soulful acoustic music rooted in California folk and bossa-infused soul. He was previously in the band King Washington and now performs solo.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from georgekrikes.net and a Voyage LA interview.
